pathways.title: FMSCT competition licence pathway
steps: Apply for the road-racing competition licence for the season
Complete a medical check as required by the federation / organiser
Complete novice / orientation requirements as published for the event
pathways.notes: High-level only — no invented clause numbers. Dedicated applicants deep-link was not found on fmsct-live.com in the 2026-09-23 pass; FIM lists racing@fmsct-live.com. Owner should add a licence form URL when the live site publishes one.
